% Converted, ltx-talk, built with lualatex -- which is the whole workaround.
% There is no source change for C-PDFTEX-MATH: the fix is the build engine, so
% an already-converted deck is repaired by rebuilding.
%
% Measured (ltx-talk 0.6.0, TeX Live 2026, three passes):
%
%   engine    pdftotext                             <math payloads
%   lualatex  Inline: g(a, b, c) and x.y and p … q.  4
%   pdflatex  Inline: g (a; b; c) and x:y and p : : : q.  0
%
% Under pdfTeX every comma becomes ';', every period ':', and \ldots ': : :'.
% The slides look right either way, so only the text layer shows it.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
